html.title: Wuo ibe HTML mbụ gị
html.body:
HTML na-akọwa nhazi ibe.

bụ isiokwu,

bụ paragraf, bụ njikọ. Tags mmeghe na mmechi na-agba ọdịnaya gburugburu. href na-egosi ebe njikọ na-aga. Malite na isiokwu doro anya na paragraf dị mkpirikpi. Okwu njikọ kwesịrị ịkọwa ebe ọ na-aga. Ibe kwesịrị doo anya n’enweghị agba ma ọ bụ foto.
html.practice: Dee HTML gbasara onwe gị: otu h1, p gbasara mmasị gị na a gaa na weebụsaịtị bara uru. Kọwaa href.
html.code:

css.title: Jiri CSS chọọ ibe mma
css.body:
CSS na-achịkwa agba, oghere na nhazi anya. Selector na-ahọrọ element; declarations dị n’ime {} na-edobe properties. Na h1 { color: green; }, h1 bụ selector, color bụ property.
Mee ka ederede dị mfe ịgụ. Obosara 900px nwere ike gafee ekwentị. max-width: 100% na-enyere ọdịnaya dabara na ihuenyo.
css.practice: Dee CSS nye isiokwu agba na paragraf padding. Kọwaa ihe mere ibe ga-eji dabara na obere ihuenyo.
css.code:
h1 { color: green; }
p { padding: 16px; max-width: 100%; }

javascript.title: Tinye mmekọrịta na JavaScript
javascript.body:
JavaScript na-aza omume. querySelector na-achọta element; addEventListener na-eme function mgbe event mere. textContent na-agbanwe ederede n’enweghị ịgụ ya dịka HTML.
Jiri button n’ezie ka keyboard nwee ike iji ya. Mee ka ibe bara uru tupu script abịa.
javascript.practice: Dee button na click listener nke na-agbanwe paragraf gaa na ozi nnabata. Kọwaa event na-amalite mgbanwe ahụ.
javascript.statement: Click event listener nwere ike ịza mgbe a na-eji button.

data.title: Jụọ ajụjụ bara uru banyere data
data.body: Data bụ ozi edekọtara. Malite na ajụjụ, tinye observations na rows na fields na columns. Ihe efu abụghị zero. Lelee units na rows ugboro abụọ. Average bụ nchikota kewara n’ọnụọgụ values.
data.practice: Ahịa kwa ụbọchị bụ 10, 20, 30. Gbakọọ average, dee unit na otu ajụjụ ọnụọgụ ndị a enweghị ike ịza.

cyber.title: Chebe akaụntụ
cyber.body: Jiri paswọọdụ dị iche maka ọrụ ọ bụla na password manager iji chekwaa ha. Multi-factor authentication na-agbakwunye nyocha. Ozi na-atụghị anya ya na-arịọ paswọọdụ ma ọ bụ code nwere ike ịbụ phishing. Mepee ọrụ ahụ n’onwe gị ka ị nyochaa.
cyber.practice: Kọwaa otu ị ga-esi lelee ozi nbanye na-atụghị anya ya. Dee ụzọ abụọ ichebe akaụntụ ule; etinyela paswọọdụ n’ezie.
cyber.statement: Ọ dị mma iziga code nbanye nye onye ọ bụla sị na ọ bụ onye nkwado.

ai.title: Ghọta amụma model
ai.body: Machine learning model na-amụta patterns site na ihe atụ. Data ọzụzụ na-emetụta amụma ya. Ọ nwere ike mehie, karịsịa mgbe ihe atụ ọhụrụ dị iche. Nyochaa ya na ihe atụ dị iche, lelee mmejọkwa.
ai.practice: Maka model na-amata mkpụrụ osisi, kọwaa ihe atụ ọzụzụ na ule dị iche. Kwuo otu ebe ọ nwere ike ịda.
ai.statement: Amụma model na-adị ziri ezi mgbe niile.

design.title: Mee nhazi maka mkpa onye ọrụ
design.body: Ahụmịhe onye ọrụ na-amalite na mmadụ na ebumnuche. Kọwaa nsogbu tupu ị see ihuenyo. Label doro anya na-enyere ịhọrọ omume. Nwalee obere sketch tupu iwulite. Lelee ebe mmadụ na-enwe nsogbu.
design.practice: See usoro atọ iji chekwaa nkuzi. Dee ebumnuche onye ọrụ na otu ajụjụ ule.
design.statement: Nnwale sketch nwere ike igosi nsogbu tupu iwulite app.

marketing.title: Hazie ozi bara uru
marketing.body: Marketing na-ejikọta onyinye bara uru na ndị chọrọ ya. Kọwaa ndị ị chọrọ iru, nsogbu ị na-edozi na omume ha ga-eme. Tụọ nsonaazụ dịka ajụjụ ndị ahịa, ọ bụghị naanị views. Emela nkwa ị na-enweghị ihe akaebe.
marketing.practice: Dee ozi mkpirikpi maka ọrụ obodo. Kwuo ndị ọ bụ maka, uru, otu omume na ụzọ ịtụ ihe ịga nke ọma.
marketing.statement: Views ka ukwuu na-apụta ndị ahịa ka ukwuu mgbe niile.

business.title: Nwalee echiche azụmahịa
business.body: Echiche azụmahịa chọrọ nsogbu onye ahịa na onyinye ga-arụ ọrụ. Gwa ndị ahịa okwu tupu itinye ego buru ibu. Revenue bụ ego batara; profit na-agụkọ expenses. Obere ule na-egosi uru mmadụ na-ahụ.
business.practice: A na-ere ihe 100, ọ na-efu 70 ịnye ya. Gbakọọ ọdịiche tupu expenses ndị ọzọ, kọwaa obere ule ndị ahịa.
business.statement: A ga-agụkọ expenses mgbe a na-atụ atụmatụ profit.

writing.title: Dee maka onye na-agụ
writing.body: Ederede doro anya nwere ebumnuche na ndị na-agụ. Tinye isi okwu na mbido, jiri okwu doro anya ma nye nzọụkwụ ọzọ. Gbanwee ahịrịokwu nwere ọtụtụ echiche. Lelee na onye na-agụ nwere ozi iji mee ihe.
writing.practice: Dee ahịrịokwu anọ kpọọ enyi ka unu mụọ ihe. Tinye ebumnuche, oge, ebe na omume ọzọ.
writing.statement: Ịmara ndị na-agụ na-enyere ịhọrọ nkọwa kwesịrị ekwesị.

project.title: Kewaa project n’ọrụ nta
project.body: Project nwere nsonaazụ, ọrụ na oke. Kewaa ọrụ, họrọ ndị ga-eme ya na dependencies. Ụfọdụ ọrụ ga-echere ọzọ ka ọ gwụ. Lelee ọganihu ma gbanwee atụmatụ.
project.practice: Hazie nzukọ ọmụmụ na ọrụ anọ, onye ga-eme nke ọ bụla na dependency otu. Kọwaa ihe ịga nke ọma ga-abụ.
project.statement: Ọrụ project niile nwere ike ịmalite n’otu oge mgbe niile.

teaching.title: Nyere mmadụ ịmụta
teaching.body: Nkuzi chọrọ ebumnuche doro anya, ihe atụ, omume na nzaghachi. Igosi nka apụtaghị na mmadụ amụtala ya. Ka onye mmụta nwalee ma kọwaa echiche ya. Jiri azịza họrọ ihe ọzọ ị ga-akụzi.
teaching.practice: Hazie nkuzi nkeji iri gbasara nka ị maara. Dee ebumnuche, omume na ajụjụ ịlele nghọta.
teaching.statement: Omume na nzaghachi na-enyere onye nkuzi ịlele nghọta.

web-semantic.title: Jiri HTML nwere ihe ọ pụtara
web-semantic.body:
header bụ mmalite, main bụ isi ọdịnaya, footer bụ ozi njedebe.

Nhazi doro anya na-enye akụkụ ọ bụla ọrụ ya. Gụọ ihe atụ site n’elu ruo n’ala ma chọpụta ihe a na-etinye, ozi dị mkpa na nsonaazụ. Gosi ozi na-adịghị kama ịmepụta ya. Akara na-agbanweghị na-eme ka nyocha na iji ọrụ ọzọ dị mfe.
web-semantic.practice: Mụọ ihe atụ ahụ, mepụta nke gị maka “Jiri HTML nwere ihe ọ pụtara”. Gbanwee otu ihe ma ọ bụ mkpebi, kọwaa nsonaazụ na ihe kpatara usoro gị ji mezuo ebumnuche.
web-semantic.statement: header bụ mmalite, main bụ isi ọdịnaya, footer bụ ozi njedebe.

web-layout.title: Mepụta nhazi dabara na ihuenyo
web-layout.body:
Grid auto-fit na-emepụta ogidi ga-adaba; minmax na-egbochi kaadị ịdị warara nke ukwuu.

Tụnyere nhọrọ site na ebumnuche doro anya kama ịma mma naanị. Ihe atụ na-egosi nhọrọ ma ọ bụ oke. Kọwaa uru na ọghọm, tụnyere n’ezi omume ma jiri ihe akaebe. Ihe na-arụ ọrụ n’otu ọnọdụ nwere ike ịchọ mgbanwe n’ọnọdụ ọzọ.
web-layout.practice: Mụọ ihe atụ ahụ, mepụta nke gị maka “Mepụta nhazi dabara na ihuenyo”. Gbanwee otu ihe ma ọ bụ mkpebi, kọwaa nsonaazụ na ihe kpatara usoro gị ji mezuo ebumnuche.
web-layout.statement: Nhọrọ mara mma bụ nke kacha mma maka ebumnuche niile.
web-layout.code: .cards { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr)); gap: 1rem; }

web-forms.title: Nata ozi site na fọm
web-forms.body:
label na-akọwa input; type=email na-enyocha ụdị ya, required anaghị anabata ihe efu.

Ule bara uru na-akọwa ihe a na-etinye na nsonaazụ a tụrụ anya tupu a lelee nke mere. Nwaa ihe atụ, mgbe ahụ nwaa ihe efu ma ọ bụ ihe a na-atụghị anya. Dee ihe mere ma mee obere mmezi. Nwalee ọzọ mgbe mmezi gasịrị iji mara na edoziwo nsogbu ahụ.
web-forms.practice: Mụọ ihe atụ ahụ, mepụta nke gị maka “Nata ozi site na fọm”. Gbanwee otu ihe ma ọ bụ mkpebi, kọwaa nsonaazụ na ihe kpatara usoro gị ji mezuo ebumnuche.
web-forms.statement: label na-akọwa input; type=email na-enyocha ụdị ya, required anaghị anabata ihe efu.

web-dom.title: Jikọta ihe omume na DOM
web-dom.body:
querySelector na-achọta ihe; addEventListener na-ejikọta omume na ọrụ; textContent na-agbanwe ederede.

Ụfọdụ usoro na-eche usoro mbụ. Soro akụ ndị dị n’ihe atụ ma kọwaa ihe ga-ebu ụzọ na ihe kpatara ya. Hazie ihe a ga-eme ma ọ bụrụ na otu usoro ada. Lelee mgbanwe ọ bụla tupu ịga n’ihu; iru njedebe naanị anaghị egosi na ọrụ niile gara nke ọma.
web-dom.practice: Mụọ ihe atụ ahụ, mepụta nke gị maka “Jikọta ihe omume na DOM”. Gbanwee otu ihe ma ọ bụ mkpebi, kọwaa nsonaazụ na ihe kpatara usoro gị ji mezuo ebumnuche.
web-dom.statement: Usoro dabere nwere ike ịmalite tupu nke mbụ mgbe niile.

web-access.title: Mee ka onye ọ bụla jiri ibe ahụ
web-access.body:
Button n’ezie na-arụ ọrụ na keyboard. Ederede chọrọ ọdịiche agba na akara omume doro anya.

Ndụmọdụ bara uru na-ekwu ihe a hụrụ ma nye usoro ọzọ. Lelee ihe atụ maka ihe akaebe nke ihe rụrụ ọrụ na ihe siri ike. Kewaa ihe ị hụrụ na ihe ị chere. Melite otu ihe ma lelee ma ọ na-enyere aka; obere otu anaghị anọchi anya onye ọ bụla.
web-access.practice: Mụọ ihe atụ ahụ, mepụta nke gị maka “Mee ka onye ọ bụla jiri ibe ahụ”. Gbanwee otu ihe ma ọ bụ mkpebi, kọwaa nsonaazụ na ihe kpatara usoro gị ji mezuo ebumnuche.
web-access.statement: Button n’ezie na-arụ ọrụ na keyboard. Ederede chọrọ ọdịiche agba na akara omume doro anya.

web-debug.title: Chọta njehie ma nwalee ọrụ
web-debug.body:
Nwalee ọnụ ọgụgụ nkịtị na efu: 5 × 3 = 15; 5 × 0 = 0.

Ule bara uru na-akọwa ihe a na-etinye na nsonaazụ a tụrụ anya tupu a lelee nke mere. Nwaa ihe atụ, mgbe ahụ nwaa ihe efu ma ọ bụ ihe a na-atụghị anya. Dee ihe mere ma mee obere mmezi. Nwalee ọzọ mgbe mmezi gasịrị iji mara na edoziwo nsogbu ahụ.
web-debug.practice: Mụọ ihe atụ ahụ, mepụta nke gị maka “Chọta njehie ma nwalee ọrụ”. Gbanwee otu ihe ma ọ bụ mkpebi, kọwaa nsonaazụ na ihe kpatara usoro gị ji mezuo ebumnuche.
web-debug.statement: Otu ule gara nke ọma na-egosi na ọrụ na-arụ n’ọnọdụ niile.

web-project.title: Mepụta weebụsaịtị nke gị
web-project.body:
Jikọta HTML nwere ihe ọ pụtara, CSS dabara na ihuenyo na omume keyboard na weebụsaịtị gị.

Jikọta nka ị mụtara na obere ọrụ. Jiri ihe atụ malite nhazi, họrọ nsonaazụ bara uru ma mepụta ihe ị pụrụ igosi. Nwalee ya site na ebumnuche gị, kọwaa otu oke na otu mmezi. Debe ndetu na ihe akaebe ka onye na-amụ ọzọ ghọta mkpebi gị.
web-project.practice: Mụọ ihe atụ ahụ, mepụta nke gị maka “Mepụta weebụsaịtị nke gị”. Gbanwee otu ihe ma ọ bụ mkpebi, kọwaa nsonaazụ na ihe kpatara usoro gị ji mezuo ebumnuche.
web-project.statement: Jikọta HTML nwere ihe ọ pụtara, CSS dabara na ihuenyo na omume keyboard na weebụsaịtị gị.

data-clean.title: Hichaa obere data
data-clean.body:
ID e degharịrị nwere ike ịbụ oyiri. Ihe efu bụ ihe a na-amaghị, ọ bụghị efu n’onwe ya.

Nhazi doro anya na-enye akụkụ ọ bụla ọrụ ya. Gụọ ihe atụ site n’elu ruo n’ala ma chọpụta ihe a na-etinye, ozi dị mkpa na nsonaazụ. Gosi ozi na-adịghị kama ịmepụta ya. Akara na-agbanweghị na-eme ka nyocha na iji ọrụ ọzọ dị mfe.
data-clean.practice: Mụọ ihe atụ ahụ, mepụta nke gị maka “Hichaa obere data”. Gbanwee otu ihe ma ọ bụ mkpebi, kọwaa nsonaazụ na ihe kpatara usoro gị ji mezuo ebumnuche.
data-clean.statement: ID e degharịrị nwere ike ịbụ oyiri. Ihe efu bụ ihe a na-amaghị, ọ bụghị efu n’onwe ya.

data-measures.title: Họrọ nha nchịkọta bara uru
data-measures.body:
Mean na-eji ọnụ ọgụgụ niile; median bụ etiti mgbe a haziri ha.

Ngụkọta chọrọ ihe a na-etinye, usoro ngụkọta na nha. Jiri aka rụọ ihe atụ tupu iji ngwaọrụ. Lelee ihe a na-ekewa, data na-adịghị na ma nsonaazụ ọ bụ ihe ezi uche. Ngụkọta ziri ezi ka chọrọ nkọwa tupu e jiri ya mee mkpebi.
data-measures.practice: Mụọ ihe atụ ahụ, mepụta nke gị maka “Họrọ nha nchịkọta bara uru”. Gbanwee otu ihe ma ọ bụ mkpebi, kọwaa nsonaazụ na ihe kpatara usoro gị ji mezuo ebumnuche.
data-measures.statement: Nha na ihe a na-ekewa adịghị mkpa na ngụkọta.

SUM na-agbakọta, AVERAGE na-achọta nha etiti, COUNT na-agụ sel nọmba.

data-sheets.statement: SUM na-agbakọta, AVERAGE na-achọta nha etiti, COUNT na-agụ sel nọmba.

data-filter.title: Hazie ma nyochaa ndekọ
data-filter.body:
Filter na-ahọrọ ahịrị dabara; sort na-agbanwe usoro ma ọ bụghị ọnụ ọgụgụ.

Tụnyere nhọrọ site na ebumnuche doro anya kama ịma mma naanị. Ihe atụ na-egosi nhọrọ ma ọ bụ oke. Kọwaa uru na ọghọm, tụnyere n’ezi omume ma jiri ihe akaebe. Ihe na-arụ ọrụ n’otu ọnọdụ nwere ike ịchọ mgbanwe n’ọnọdụ ọzọ.

data-filter.statement: Nhọrọ mara mma bụ nke kacha mma maka ebumnuche niile.

GROUP BY na-emepụta otu; SUM na-agbakọta nke otu ọ bụla.

data-privacy.title: Chebe ozi mmadụ
data-privacy.body:
ID kama aha na-ebelata mkpughe, mana ozi ọzọ ka nwere ike igosi onye.

Jiri ozi emepụtara maka omume a. Nata naanị ihe dị mkpa, wepụ ihe na-egosi onye ma belata ndị ga-ahụ ya. Ihe atụ na-egosi ozi a ga-ewepụ ma ọ bụ ikike a ga-elele. E deela paswọọdụ n’ezie, ozi kọntaktị ma ọ bụ ndekọ nzuzo na ndetu gị.
data-privacy.practice: Mụọ ihe atụ ahụ, mepụta nke gị maka “Chebe ozi mmadụ”. Gbanwee otu ihe ma ọ bụ mkpebi, kọwaa nsonaazụ na ihe kpatara usoro gị ji mezuo ebumnuche.
data-privacy.statement: ID kama aha na-ebelata mkpughe, mana ozi ọzọ ka nwere ike igosi onye.

data-evidence.title: Kọwaa nchọpụta na oke ya
data-evidence.body:
Kọwaa nha otu na ejighị n’aka. Mmekọrịta anaghị egosi ihe kpatara ihe ọzọ.

cyber-phishing.title: Chọpụta njikọ aghụghọ
cyber-phishing.body:
Lelee hostname n’ezie: example.test.evil.test bụ nke evil.test, ọ bụghị example.test.

cyber-privacy.title: Debe ozi nzuzo
cyber-privacy.body:

Jiri ozi emepụtara maka omume a. Nata naanị ihe dị mkpa, wepụ ihe na-egosi onye ma belata ndị ga-ahụ ya. Ihe atụ na-egosi ozi a ga-ewepụ ma ọ bụ ikike a ga-elele. E deela paswọọdụ n’ezie, ozi kọntaktị ma ọ bụ ndekọ nzuzo na ndetu gị.

design-access.body:
Lelee ọdịiche agba, keyboard, focus, label na zoom n’enweghị izochi ọdịnaya.

design-usability.title: Mee ule iji ya

Nye ọrụ n’ezie ma lelee n’enweghị nkuzi; dee ebe onye ahụ kwụsịrị.

design-project.title: Gosi atụmatụ a nwalere

marketing-audience.body:

marketing-value.statement: Nhọrọ mara mma bụ nke kacha mma maka ebumnuche niile.

Nnwale na-amalite na ajụjụ a pụrụ ịlele na nha ihe ịga nke ọma. Ihe atụ na-agbanwe otu ihe ma debe ndị ọzọ otu. Dee nsonaazụ mbido, mee obere ule ma tụnyere. Otu nsonaazụ anaghị ekwe nkwa otu ihe n’ọnọdụ ma ọ bụ otu ọ bụla.

business-operations.title: Hazie ọrụ nnyefe
business-operations.body:
See usoro site n’ịtụ ihe ruo nnyocha ọzọ; họrọ onye ga-enyocha ịdị mma.

Ụfọdụ usoro na-eche usoro mbụ. Soro akụ ndị dị n’ihe atụ ma kọwaa ihe ga-ebu ụzọ na ihe kpatara ya. Hazie ihe a ga-eme ma ọ bụrụ na otu usoro ada. Lelee mgbanwe ọ bụla tupu ịga n’ihu; iru njedebe naanị anaghị egosi na ọrụ niile gara nke ọma.
business-operations.practice: Mụọ ihe atụ ahụ, mepụta nke gị maka “Hazie ọrụ nnyefe”. Gbanwee otu ihe ma ọ bụ mkpebi, kọwaa nsonaazụ na ihe kpatara usoro gị ji mezuo ebumnuche.
business-operations.statement: Usoro dabere nwere ike ịmalite tupu nke mbụ mgbe niile.
business-operations.code: order → confirm → prepare → check → deliver → follow up

business-records.title: Debe obere ndekọ azụmahịa
business-records.body:
Dee ụbọchị, ụdị, ọnụ ọgụgụ na reference; debe ihe akaebe ego ọ bụla.

business-risk.title: Kwadebe maka ihe ize ndụ azụmahịa
business-risk.body:
Chọpụta ihe ọrụ dabere, tụọ ihe ize ndụ ma kwadebe ụzọ ọzọ.

Ihe ize ndụ jikọtara ohere ihe ga-eme na nsogbu ọ ga-ebute. Tụnyere ohere na mmetụta n’ihe atụ ma họrọ ụzọ nche. Bido na nnukwu ihe ize ndụ ma họrọ onye ga-eme ihe. Ndepụta nyocha na-ebelata njehie ma ọ naghị ewepụ egwu niile.

business-project.title: Gosi echiche azụmahịa a nwalere
business-project.body:
Gosi ihe akaebe onye ahịa, ọnụ ahịa ọrụ, ule na atụmatụ ego nwere ajụjụ.

Jikọta nka ị mụtara na obere ọrụ. Jiri ihe atụ malite nhazi, họrọ nsonaazụ bara uru ma mepụta ihe ị pụrụ igosi. Nwalee ya site na ebumnuche gị, kọwaa otu oke na otu mmezi. Debe ndetu na ihe akaebe ka onye na-amụ ọzọ ghọta mkpebi gị.

business-project.statement: Gosi ihe akaebe onye ahịa, ọnụ ahịa ọrụ, ule na atụmatụ ego nwere ajụjụ.

writing-purpose.title: Kọwaa onye na-agụ na ebumnuche
writing-purpose.body:
Chọpụta onye na-agụ, ebumnuche ozi na ihe ọ ga-eme ọzọ.

Malite na onye chọrọ ọrụ ahụ na ihe ọ chọrọ ime. Ihe atụ jikọtara mkpa, azịza bara uru na usoro ọzọ. Nye nkọwa zuru oke, jiri okwu nkwanye ùgwù ma zere okwu enweghị ihe akaebe. Lelee ọrụ ahụ na onye n’otu ị chọrọ iru.

writing-purpose.statement: Chọpụta onye na-agụ, ebumnuche ozi na ihe ọ ga-eme ọzọ.

writing-clarity.title: Mee ka ahịrịokwu dị mfe
writing-clarity.body:
Wepụ okwu e degharịrị ma kewaa ahịrịokwu juru n’enweghị ịtụfu ihe ọ pụtara.

Tụnyere nhọrọ site na ebumnuche doro anya kama ịma mma naanị. Ihe atụ na-egosi nhọrọ ma ọ bụ oke. Kọwaa uru na ọghọm, tụnyere n’ezi omume ma jiri ihe akaebe. Ihe na-arụ ọrụ n’otu ọnọdụ nwere ike ịchọ mgbanwe n’ọnọdụ ọzọ.

writing-evidence.title: Jiri ihe akaebe kwado okwu
writing-evidence.body:
Lelee okwu na isi mmalite mbụ, ụbọchị na ihe akaebe.

Ule bara uru na-akọwa ihe a na-etinye na nsonaazụ a tụrụ anya tupu a lelee nke mere. Nwaa ihe atụ, mgbe ahụ nwaa ihe efu ma ọ bụ ihe a na-atụghị anya. Dee ihe mere ma mee obere mmezi. Nwalee ọzọ mgbe mmezi gasịrị iji mara na edoziwo nsogbu ahụ.

writing-edit.title: Dezie n’usoro
writing-edit.body:

teaching-check.title: Lelee nka na ihe atụ ọhụrụ
teaching-check.body:

Ule bara uru na-akọwa ihe a na-etinye na nsonaazụ a tụrụ anya tupu a lelee nke mere. Nwaa ihe atụ, mgbe ahụ nwaa ihe efu ma ọ bụ ihe a na-atụghị anya. Dee ihe mere ma mee obere mmezi. Nwalee ọzọ mgbe mmezi gasịrị iji mara na edoziwo nsogbu ahụ.

teaching-check.statement: Otu ule gara nke ọma na-egosi na ọrụ na-arụ n’ọnọdụ niile.
